agent_notes: Normal TLS verification hit the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to confirmed Google, Bing and hte.rajasthan.gov.in hosts.

The official HTE directory identifies the Dausa campus as Swargiya P.N.K.S. Government PG College, Dausa, portal slug gcscdausa, Dausa district, Old NH-11, Agra Road, Dausa, and CoEd/PG; this matches the NIRF city and the abbreviated NIRF name.

The official catalogue is internally inconsistent: the homepage Our Course section lists M.Sc.(Botany), M.Sc.(Chemistry), M.Sc.(Mathematics), M.Sc.(Physics), and M.Sc.(Zoology), while the PG catalogue page lists M. Sc. Chemistry plus B.C.A. Self Finance Scheme and PGDCA, and omits the other M.Sc. subjects.

The current admission catalogue shows 2026-27 UG and BCA admission evidence, while PGDCA has a catalogue listing but no corresponding current admission entry found; the active programme set therefore requires manual review.
The Agriculture College menu is a nodal-college contact page naming separate Government Agriculture Colleges at Khedla Bujurg and Behrawanda; those other campuses were excluded.
